title: You Raise Me Up

cues.en: When I am down and oh my soul so weary
cues.zh: 每當我低落消沉、心靈疲憊不堪之時
cues.text: When I am down and oh my soul so weary

cues.en: When troubles come and my heart burdened be
cues.zh: 當麻煩來臨，我的心負擔
cues.text: When troubles come and my heart burdened be

cues.en: Then I am still and wait here in the silence
cues.zh: 那我就安安靜靜地在這裡等著
cues.text: Then I am still and wait here in the silence

cues.en: Until you come and sit a while with me
cues.zh: 直到你來和我坐一會兒
cues.text: Until you come and sit a while with me

cues.en: You raise me up, so I can stand on mountains
cues.zh: 你把我抬起來，所以我可以站在山上
cues.text: You raise me up, so I can stand on mountains

cues.en: You raise me up, to walk on stormy seas
cues.zh: 你把我扶起來，在暴風雨的大海上行走
cues.text: You raise me up, to walk on stormy seas

cues.en: I am strong, when I am on your shoulders
cues.zh: 當我站在你的肩膀上時，我很強大
cues.text: I am strong, when I am on your shoulders

cues.en: You raise me up, to more than I can be
cues.zh: 你把我提升到超越我的能力
